intended_behavior: Add a new optional attribute cache_strategy: Optional[str] = None to the base Model class configuration so that all model implementations inherit this parameter for cache strategy configuration.

Modify Agent constructor to check if model.get_config().get("cache_strategy") == "auto". If true, automatically register the ConversationCachingHook with self.hooks to enable the hook-based automatic prompt caching feature.

Implement a new hook class ConversationCachingHook that implements the HookProvider protocol. It should provide a register_hooks function which registers a callback on BeforeModelCallEvent in order to inject a cachePoint dictionary into the last assistant message’s content before each model call, thereby enabling automatic caching according to the issue description.
